title: Tidelines
subtitle: An atlas of changing edges
deck: Two curved fields meet without quite touching. This second cover studies the boundary between a solid shape and the space it leaves behind.
construction: The atlas uses the same single-edge construction as Field notes. The cover turns around its left seam, the paper stack shifts slightly, and the annotation arrives after the inside face becomes readable.
note: The green shape leans across a chalk surface. Above it, a cropped orange ring suggests another contour passing out of view. The shared format lets colour and placement carry the difference between the two studies. Neither design is offered as a finished physical product.
